confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2009 (electric kettle, Home category, AED 189.00) was delivered 2026-11-01 and the return was requested 2026-11-02, 0.9 days later, inside the 14-day Return v2 window.
The return pickup has not happened; the last courier event is a pickup attempt where the customer asked to reschedule.
No warehouse receipt or inspection record exists for this return.
No scans or photos exist for this return or order.

findings.description: The customer describes the damage (message in Arabic: kettle lid hinge broken on receipt, box crushed) and says a photo will follow, but no photo has been provided. Return v2 2.3 asks for a description and at least one photo; the claim stays open until provided. A clarification request to the customer is drafted (DRAFT-RET-2009-CUSTOMER).
The item has not been collected or received, so there is no warehouse inspection to confirm the damage. This is not a system failure; the return is still awaiting pickup.

policy_references.quote: Without them, the claim stays open until they are provided.
Home and other non-electronic items: **14 days** from delivery.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the window, but the damage claim has no photo and the item has not been collected or inspected. The customer has described the damage and said a photo will follow. A request to the customer for the photo and a new pickup time is drafted for a person to approve.
findings.uncertainty_note: Damage is unconfirmed: no photo and no warehouse inspection exist yet. The customer can supply the photo and the warehouse can inspect once the item is collected.
